sloka: मुञ्च रामाद्भयं राजन् हनिष्यामीह संयुगे ।राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं च महाबलम् ।हनुमन्तं च रक्षोघ्नं लङ्का येन प्रदीपिता ।। ६.६३.४९ ।।
transliteration: muñca rāmādbhayaṁ rājan haniṣyāmīha saṁyuge ।rāghavaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva sugrīvaṁ ca mahābalam ।hanumantaṁ ca rakṣoghnaṁ laṅkā yena pradīpitā ।। 6.63.49 ।।

translations.english: "O King! Give up the fear, as both Rama and Lakshmana will be made short of work in the battlefield, as also mighty Sugriva and dispose of Hanuman, the destroyer of many Rakshasas and who set fire to Lanka."
